p: Progress can be difficult to see when goals, observations and outcomes are spread across sessions, therapists and settings, making it harder to understand what is working and where a child needs more support.

CognitiveBotics uses AI powered tools to help keep intervention connected across therapy, home and school, making it easier to reinforce learning, monitor progress and support meaningful skill generalisation.

p: Reading & Writing
Fosters literacy by improving the ability to read, comprehend and write.
Arithmetic Skill
Enhances basic mathematical understanding and problem-solving abilities.
Visual Skill
Improves how children interpret and understand visual information from their environment.
Social Skill
Builds the ability to interact, communicate and engage positively with others.
Play Skill
Encourages imaginative play and the development of problem-solving and creative thinking.
Self-Help Skill
Promotes independence by teaching children essential daily living activities.
Attending Skill
Enhances a child’s ability to focus and maintain attention on tasks or instructions.
Imitation Skill
Helps children learn by observing and mimicking others’ actions or behaviors.
Receptive Skill
Strengthens the child’s ability to understand and process spoken language and instructions.
Expressive Skill
Develops the child’s capability to communicate thoughts, needs and emotions effectively.

Understanding a child's developmental strengths and areas of need can help teams identify where closer attention may be helpful and guide the next conversation. Our 14-question developmental checklist provides an initial view across key developmental areas.
